import { mkdtempSync, rmSync } from "node:fs";
import { tmpdir } from "node:os";
import { join } from "node:path";
import { expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { seed } from "../../workload/seed.ts";
import { buildApp } from "../src/app.ts";
import { loadConfig } from "../src/platform/config.ts";
import { openDb } from "../src/platform/db.ts";
import { createSession } from "../src/platform/session/session.ts";

it("bounds materialized browse rows by its page and retains fresh private availability at full scale [QLT-12]", async () => {
  const directory = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), "loan-browse-bound-")), path = join(directory, "app.db");
  await seed(path, "synthetic seed password");
  const db = openDb(path), config = loadConfig({ NODE_ENV: "test", LOG_LEVEL: "silent", DATABASE_URL: path });
  const signed = createSession(db, "user-0", config.cookieSecret, Date.now());
  const app = await buildApp(config, { db });
  const materialized: number[] = [], prepare = db.prepare.bind(db);
  // Observe the actual driver output without replacing results or depending on SQL spelling.
  const observer = vi.spyOn(db, "prepare").mockImplementation(sql => {
    const statement = prepare(sql), all = statement.all.bind(statement);
    Object.defineProperty(statement, "all", { value: (...params: unknown[]) => {
      const rows = all(...params); materialized.push(rows.length); return rows;
    } });
    return statement;
  });
  const cookies = { sid: signed.cookie }, headers = { "x-csrf-token": signed.session.csrf };
  try {
    for (const offset of [0, 4990, 9990]) {
      const response = await app.inject({ method: "GET", url: `/api/items?limit=25&offset=${offset}`, cookies });
      expect(response.statusCode).toBe(200);
      const body = response.json() as { items: Array<{ id: string; name: string; available: boolean }>; total: number };
      expect(body.total).toBe(10000); expect(body.items).toHaveLength(Math.min(25, 10000 - offset));
      for (const item of body.items) {
        const id = Number(item.id.slice("item-".length));
        expect(item.available).toBe(!(id >= 1 && id <= 5000));
        expect(Object.keys(item).sort()).toEqual(["available", "id", "name"]);
      }
      expect(Math.max(...materialized)).toBeLessThanOrEqual(25);
    }
    const reserved = await app.inject({ method: "POST", url: "/api/items/item-0/reserve", cookies, headers });
    expect(reserved.statusCode).toBe(200);
    const page = await app.inject({ method: "GET", url: "/api/items?limit=25", cookies });
    expect(page.json().items.find((item: { id: string }) => item.id === "item-0").available).toBe(false);
    expect((await app.inject({ method: "POST", url: `/api/loans/${reserved.json().id}/return`, cookies, headers })).statusCode).toBe(200);
    const fresh = await app.inject({ method: "GET", url: "/api/items?limit=25", cookies });
    expect(fresh.json().items.find((item: { id: string }) => item.id === "item-0").available).toBe(true);
    expect(materialized.length).toBeGreaterThan(0); expect(Math.max(...materialized)).toBeLessThanOrEqual(25);
  } finally { observer.mockRestore(); await app.close(); db.close(); rmSync(directory, { recursive: true, force: true }); }
});
